run_pybullet_rolling_demo: run the pybullet rolling demo to simulate a DIGIT sensor with a rolling object
create_tacto_sensor: create a TACTO sensor instance using config parameters and a background image
create_pybullet_body: create a pybulletX Body from config to represent a DIGIT or object in simulation
add_camera_to_sensor: add a camera linked to a body ID to the TACTO sensor for rendering
start_simulation_thread: start a background simulation thread with a configurable real-time factor
